case_title: Hussein Ghadially @M.H.G.A. ShaiKH v. State of Gujarat
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; Arms Act s.27
neutral_facts: Two twin bomb blasts occurred in the city of Surat, resulting in multiple casualties. The prosecution alleged that the accused, including Hussein Ghadially and others, planned and executed the blasts as a form of retaliation against the majority community following communal riots. The accused were alleged to have collected and distributed weapons, including firearms, grenades, and bombs, to individuals gathered at a relief camp. The investigation led to the arrest of several accused and the recovery of arms and ammunition. The trial court convicted some accused persons and sentenced them to imprisonment ranging between 10 to 20 years, while others were acquitted. The High Court and Supreme Court later overturned the convictions due to procedural violations in the application of the Terrorist and Disruptive Activities (Prevention) Act.
